banks.title: Lab 1: Python Basics
banks.description: Your first Python programs: printing output, reading input with input(), converting text to numbers with int(), storing values in variables and doing arithmetic.

banks.title: Lab 2: Variables and Conditions
banks.description: Comments, variables and basic types (int, float, string), making decisions with if-else, and a first look at while loops, ending with a multiplication table.

banks.title: Lab 3: Loops and Lists
banks.description: While loops, for loops and range(), nested loops for printing patterns, and an introduction to lists: indexing, the in operator and looping over a list.

banks.title: Lab 4: Functions
banks.description: Defining and calling functions, parameters and return values, functions calling other functions, multiple return values, functions on lists, and a first look at recursion.

banks.title: Lab 4B: Type Hints
banks.description: Adding type hints (int, float, str, bool, list) to function parameters and return values, from filling in a hinted function to writing full hinted signatures yourself.

banks.title: Lab 5: Recursion
banks.description: Classic recursive problems (factorial, power, GCD, Fibonacci, digit sums), recursion over lists using an index, and a recursive selection sort.

banks.title: Lab 6: Errors and Debugging
banks.description: Reading error messages and fixing broken code: syntax, indentation, NameError, TypeError, IndexError and more, then finding logical errors that give no message at all.

banks.title: Practice Set 1
banks.description: Easy, medium and difficult questions covering all topics from Labs 1 to 5.

banks.title: Practice Set 2
banks.description: All topics from Labs 1 to 5, plus debug-it type questions.
